$comment: Draft from docs/portfolio.md, 'Contracts'. The fields follow what asset-handoff's read-only verbs print today (`handoff compute names`, `compute tags`, `compute form`, and the identity check across the media library and the form), read from its main branch; the pack aligns to this schema once it is agreed. The upload to a media library is the operator's own write, not part of this document.
title: handoff.batch/1
description: One batch of creatives ready to be handed to an operator: each creative's name across its sizes, its files, its UTM tags, its row in the client's form, and whether the names agree in the media library and the form. asset-handoff writes it; operators read it to upload and to name what they upload.

check.description: The producer's code for the finding.

severity.description: block: the creative or family is not ready; warn: a person decides.

subject.description: What the finding is about (a family, a file, a name), when it names one.

x-rules: A creative that is not ready (status blocked) is listed with its findings and carries no utm and no form_row: an operator uploads only ready creatives.
A name is the final name the file will carry in the library; an operator uploads under exactly that name.
An absent optional key means unknown, never null and never an empty string; places.library or places.form absent means that place was not checked.

producer.description: The pack that wrote the document (its CLI word).

produced_at.description: When the document was written: ISO 8601 with its zone.

batch.description: The batch's id, stable across the documents that repeat it.

creatives.description: One entry per creative family (all the sizes of one creative); empty when the batch has none.

family.description: The creative's family id: what its sizes share.

status.description: ready when every file has its final name and no required size is missing; blocked otherwise.

campaign.description: The campaign value the tags carry, one the client allows.

missing_sizes.description: The required sizes the family lacks.

files.description: The family's files, one per size.

path.description: The file's path in the batch.

size.description: The size the file is for, in the client's words (for example 1080x1920).

name.description: The final name from the client's naming template; empty only when the file is blocked.

places.description: Whether the name is in each place it should be, once those were given.

library.description: In the media library: ok, drift (a nearly identical name is there instead), missing or not_given.

form.description: In the client's form: ok, drift, missing or not_given.

utm.description: The family's tracking, present only when it is ready.

tags.description: The UTM query string in the client's order, percent-encoded.

url.description: The family's copy URL with the tags appended.

content.description: The content value, from the client's table.

form_row.description: The family's row for the client's form, as {form column header: value}; a column the form fills by a formula is left out.

findings.description: Why the family is blocked, or what a person should look at.
Findings about the batch as a whole (two files with one name, identical bytes under two files).
